title: (fix) Fix stock report generation, visibility, downloads, and role-based access

## Summary
<!-- Please describe what problems your PR addresses. -->

This resolves the long-standing stock reporting issue where submitted reports remain pending, fail to appear in the report list, or cannot be downloaded.

Changes include:

- Repairing and automatically configuring the background scheduler responsible for report generation.
- Correctly displaying queued, running, completed, failed, cancelled, expired, and stale report statuses.
- Restoring completed report downloads.
- Ensuring newly created reports appear in the report table.
- Restricting report viewing, generation, cancellation, and downloads to users assigned the Inventory Reporting role.
- Preserving location-based access restrictions for reporting users.
- Improving report submission and status messages in the frontend.
